assessments.reasoning: The assignment headings lead to a value-adjustment rule. Components come first in arbitrary order. The object-level hook follows only for nonlimited controlled objects. The package declaration and paragraph 9/2 exclude an Adjust primitive on Limited_Controlled itself.

challenge.method: Compare §7.6(9/2,13–16/3) with the separate anonymous assignment object, no-effect categories, and omission permissions.
challenge.results: Adjustment can have no effect on the listed categories. Whole assignments or certain calls can be omitted under narrow permissions. The claim concerns the stated value adjustment and does not imply an exact dynamic hook count or forbid a separately declared same-name routine.

limitations: This describes abstract value adjustment, not a promise that every physical assignment calls every hook. The manual provides specific implementation permissions and describes no-effect cases for elementary objects and composites with no controlled parts.
Exact unannotated Ada 2022 manual edition only. Runtime implementations and other editions require separate evidence.
